review_evidence: README describes a type-safe HTTP/1.1 client library built on curl, with URL/request/response types, transport and client APIs, examples, and imperative tests.

The HttpClient production modules define runtime data structures, parsers/builders, process-backed transport, and client operations; a complete repository proposition-declaration scan finds zero theorem, lemma, example, or axiom declarations.
Tests.lean checks behavior procedurally and Example.lean is an IO demonstration; there is no checked RFC semantics or correctness/refinement theorem.

source_action.content_invariant: Its Lean sources implement HTTP parsing/building/transport and procedural tests, with zero proposition declarations and no checked RFC semantics or correctness result, so retirement removes no mathematical/formal statement or proof development.
